title: Filter numbers greater than 5
description: Write a function `filter_greater_than_5(numbers)` that returns a NEW list containing only the numbers greater than 5.
hints: This time the accumulator isn't a number, it's a list you build up.
Start with an empty list, and use `.append()` when a number passes the condition.
expected_behavior: Returns a new list, preserving the original order.
explanation: Filtering is the list version of the accumulator pattern: instead of updating a single number, we grow a list, adding only the elements that satisfy the condition.
